name: zinput_on_app_activate
description: zInput::OnAppActivate resumes suspended input devices when the input window exists, marks the mouse active, and updates mouse acquisition.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly validates the early return when g_zInput_hWnd is null and otherwise calls joystick, keyboard, and mouse resume helpers before setting g_zInput_MouseActive and tail-calling Mouse_UpdateAcquireState.
The native smoke verifies resumed suspend flags, active mouse state, and acquisition.
